Built a polished, responsive bookmark manager with:

- Add bookmarks with URL, title, notes, collection, and tags
- Search with `⌘/Ctrl + K`
- Collections and favorites
- Archive and restore functionality
- Grid/list views and sorting
- Local browser persistence
- Responsive desktop and mobile layouts

Verified the production build and core interactions with Playwright.

Open the app at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
